messages:
incident-bot: Paging on-call SREs: elevated 5xx + timeouts observed from private VPC customers through gateway-proxy-2. High error rate started ~10m ago. Routing/gateway errors, some TCP stalls. @sre-rotation please ack.
ashley: acked. looking at dashboards now. seeing 502/504 spike and increased connection resets from 10:12->10:22.
sam: which infra path? peering or NAT?
mika: initial correlation shows most spans egressing via nat-cluster-a, but a subset goes through peer-gw-1 and those show higher latencies. could be affinity/translation issue.
carlos: I’m seeing ephemeral port exhaustion counters rising on nat-cluster-a nodes. conntrack tables also show churn.
ashley: ok, hypothesis: NAT affinity flap causing asymmetric translation and timeouts. impact: approx 12% of private-vpc inference requests returning 5xx to customers; a handful reported timeouts from customer dashboards.
sre-rotation: @mika take lead on mitigation. @carlos coordinate any host-level actions.
mika: running quick tcpdump on gateway-proxy-2 to confirm resets. command: ```sudo tcpdump -n -i eth0 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-rst) != 0' | head -n 50```
carlos: pulling conntrack summary: ```conntrack -S | grep ephemeral``` shows spike in NEW entries and timeouts. ephemeral port pool near saturation on 3/8 nodes.
sam: any recent firewall/security-group changes pushed?
ashley: Security pushed a minor sg rule change 09:50 that narrowed outbound ports for a subset of subnets. tagging @deploy-bot for rollout record.
deploy-bot: change 2026-03-15T09:50 UTC: security-group-outbound-restrict v2 -> applied to subnet-private-2 (owner: security).
mika: that matches impacted subnets. likely reduction in ephemeral port range + sticky NAT created port reuse, causing resets. Suggested mitigations: 1) revert sg change for subnet-private-2, 2) increase ephemeral port allocation on nat nodes temporarily, 3) add short-lived route to failover to nat-cluster-b.
sre-rotation: prioritize revert + failover. Carlos, do rollback for SG change with security OK?
carlos: pinging security for rollback approval. Sending ask to #security now: "urgent rollback request: outbound port restriction causing customer 5xx, need revert to previous sg on subnet-private-2"
customer-support: ping — customers affected: cust-acme and cust-lumen seeing elevated 5xx rates and long-tail inference timeouts. Notifying both with incident notice.
security: (via #security) oncall here, we see the sg change; security approves emergency revert for affected subnet.
carlos: rolling back rule now. command: ```aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress/remove-rule ...``` (internal run) — completed on subnet-private-2.
mika: while rollback applied, initiating failover: updating routing policy to shift traffic off nat-cluster-a to nat-cluster-b for subnet-private-2: ```/infra/runbooks/nat/failover.sh subnet-private-2 nat-cluster-b --dry-run=false```
sam: also bumping conntrack_max and ephemeral port range on nat-cluster-a nodes to absorb burst: ```sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=2000000; sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range='15000 65535'``` executed on 3 nodes.
ashley: metrics starting to improve: 5xx rate down from 12% -> 3% within 2 minutes of revert, timeouts dropping. still watching.
carlos: conntrack entries decreasing, ephemeral headroom restored.
ashley: can we keep nat-cluster-b warm for 15m and keep sg reverted while we monitor?
mika: yes. will keep route shift for 20m then gradually move back if stable.
sre-rotation: @customer-support keep customers updated: initial mitigation applied, rollback done, failover in place. Provide ETA 30m for full stability checks.
customer-support: notified cust-acme & cust-lumen with status and ETA 30m. both acknowledged, cust-acme opened a support ticket asking for postmortem.
ashley: quick checklist: 1) confirm no other subnets affected — running scan, 2) gather logs for postmortem, 3) coordinate with security on long-term remediation (don't push restrictive sg without cross-checking ephemeral ranges).
mika: collecting tcpdumps and router traces; saving to internal bucket: s3://redwood-incident-logs/2824001234/
carlos: leaving ephemeral port expansion in place for 30m; document exact sysctl changes in runbook.
sre-rotation: good job. once 30m passes with stable 5xx <1% we can deescalate. open a followup thread for postmortem.
ashley: will start a postmortem draft. adding ashley, sam, mika, carlos, security to the doc.
deploy-bot: rollback change recorded: security-group-outbound-restrict v2 -> reverted (change-id: ch-4092).
incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated. Impact reduced to 2% errors at 10:45 UTC. Keep monitoring.
customer-support: customers updated again; both will wait for postmortem.
sre-rotation: moving to watch; if errors spike, reopen paging. closing thread in 40m if stable.
ashley: thanks all — free to hand off to next oncall if needed.
--- End of thread ---
